text: Mike Enslin, a skeptical author who writes about haunted places he does not believe in, receives a postcard of New York's Dolphin hotel bearing the words [Don't enter 1408|trigger|breaking a rule]. The manager warns that no guest has lasted an hour there, but Mike insists, and soon [the clock radio counts down from sixty minutes|rules|death on a deadline]. Ghosts of past victims appear, the room floods and freezes, and [visions of his dead daughter Katie|who_suffers|the grieving] follow him through [a room that will not let him leave|threat|evil places].
